cb18_rules_pre.ARM_PROJECTION_RULE: projected arm-0 count = census units whose Gamma event (else market) id hashes to arm 0 x W / census days; unsplit = all census units x W / census days
cb18_rules_pre.BURST_RULE: denominator: non-sports units of the capture passing (1)-(10) whose class is silent or quiet; numerator: the silent ones; burst iff numerator > 0.20 x denominator
cb18_rules_pre.CAPTURE_TIME_RULE: a capture's time is the received_utc of its last page (the maximum received_utc over its rows); its slot is the LT3 slot of its start stamp (first complete capture of a slot wins)

S: selected permutation strata level (at the route's q)

cb18_rules_pre.COMP_INFORMATIVE_RULE: share of silent + quiet units in composition strata holding both labels; the finest level with share >= 60% (none -> null, reported)
cb18_rules_pre.DE_RULE: DE_computed = 1 + (m_W - 1) x 0.02, m = sum n_e^2 / sum n_e by event, m_W = m x W / census days; DE_gate = max(3.0, DE_computed); NaN m -> NaN -> the gate fails
cb18_rules_pre.DORMANCY_TERCILE_RULE: global tercile cut points (numpy 'linear' quantiles 1/3, 2/3) of dormancy over the S frame population (features only); a value <= the lower cut is tercile 0, <= the upper cut 1, else 2
cb18_rules_pre.FRAME_POPULATION: silent and quiet non-sports units passing (1)-(12) whose look-back status is not lookback_missing (lookback_unavailable units are counted in the frame: the gap is a census artefact)
cb18_rules_pre.F_RULE: per capture k (with slot k - 1 present) and fee_type: non-sports active open markets grouped by Gamma event id (else market id); events ranked by the sum of members' volume24hr (descending, ties by event id); a rank position p in [max(1, B - 10), B + 10] changes hands iff the event at p differs between k - 1 and k; an entry across B is an event with rank <= B at k and > B (or absent) at k - 1, an exit the reverse; a crossing carries the surge label iff any member market has E017's S label at k. No price is read.
cb18_rules_pre.GP5_RULE: R2 finding 3: GP5 holds iff MDE_GP5 = max(MDE_formula, MDE_proxy) <= 0.5c. MDE_formula = 3.388 x 5c x sqrt(1/n_fade + 1/n_none) x sqrt(DE_gate) x 1.5 on projected effective fades and projected effective none units (projected = census x 28 x 12 / 21; effective = units in markets with >= 2 units of the population), DE_gate = max(3.0, DE_computed with W = 28). MDE_proxy = 3.388 x SE_proxy x sqrt(21 / (28 x 12)) x sqrt(max(3, DE_W28 / DE_census)) x 1.5, SE_proxy = the 1[fade] coefficient's census SE on c_pre (max over the event and 6 h block ways). Both values are written. NaN proxy -> MDE_formula alone; NaN formula -> GP5 fails.

GP_DEFINITIONS.GP1: projected 28-day fades >= 2,000 in the routed population
GP_DEFINITIONS.GP2: fades between 20% and 80% of reacted (fade + follow) units
GP_DEFINITIONS.GP3: side unusable (not BUY/SELL, or outcome unknown) <= 10% of rows in the state windows
GP_DEFINITIONS.GP5: R2 finding 3: GP5 holds iff MDE_GP5 = max(MDE_formula, MDE_proxy) <= 0.5c. MDE_formula = 3.388 x 5c x sqrt(1/n_fade + 1/n_none) x sqrt(DE_gate) x 1.5 on projected effective fades and projected effective none units (projected = census x 28 x 12 / 21; effective = units in markets with >= 2 units of the population), DE_gate = max(3.0, DE_computed with W = 28). MDE_proxy = 3.388 x SE_proxy x sqrt(21 / (28 x 12)) x sqrt(max(3, DE_W28 / DE_census)) x 1.5, SE_proxy = the 1[fade] coefficient's census SE on c_pre (max over the event and 6 h block ways). Both values are written. NaN proxy -> MDE_formula alone; NaN formula -> GP5 fails.
GP_DEFINITIONS.GP6: permutable share (fade versus none) >= 60% at some ladder level

GS_DEFINITIONS.GS1: updated_at changed (epoch ms differ) in <= 50% of non-sports intervals passing (1)-(9) (numerically unchanged incl. the chg_* byte flags, book untouched) with updated_at parseable at both
GS_DEFINITIONS.GS2: updated_at changed in <= 50% of non-sports intervals passing (1)-(7) with updated_at parseable at both
GS_DEFINITIONS.GS3: updated_at missing / unparseable / after received_utc + 5 s at k - 1 or k in <= 10% of intervals passing (1)-(7) (sports and non-sports)
GS_DEFINITIONS.GS4: silent non-sports units passing (1)-(11) (R1 definition: chg_* flags equal, uma empty literal at k) per census day >= 200 (count / 2 census days)
GS_DEFINITIONS.GS5: permutable share >= 60% at some ladder level on silent and quiet units thinned at the route's own q (GS5_CB at q_CB for RS-1, GS5_LT at q_LT for RS-2); fails at both -> RS-0

cb18_rules_pre.J4R_DISCLOSURE: R2 finding 1: the pre-censuses read inside J4-R [2026-10-16, 2026-10-21): census S and F read the complete captures of 2026-10-16 and sweep 1 of its passes; census P and the race map read the 23 trade samples of 2026-10-16/17 and the captures of 2026-10-16/17. CB18 follows LT3's rule (J4-R is refused only for maker mark-out objects; LIVE_TESTS_3.md:529). No census object is a mark-out: every census reads origin-side fields at or before each unit's decision time (captures k - 12 .. k, sweep 1 of pass k, trade rows with ts at or before the pass k + 1 origin) and writes counts, shares and standard errors only; no forward price, target, mark or outcome is read or written (the result writer refuses such keys). 'J4-R untouched' holds for window paths only. The CB13-T HOLDOUT [2026-10-21, 2026-10-26) is untouched by every CB18 path (census row cut-off 2026-10-17T23:01Z, window floor 2026-10-26T00:00Z).
cb18_rules_pre.M_EXIT_RULE: exit = a market present in complete capture j and absent from the next two available complete captures of the map window; recorded at its last presence; last presence after 2026-10-15T20:00Z -> undetermined; exits recorded at 2026-10-13T22:31Z (the last capture before the declared gap) carry gap_adjacent; re-appearance after an exit counted
cb18_rules_pre.M_FORBIDDEN: no comparison of an earlier price with the last mid, no return, no P&L, no side of 0.5 (bands are folded d = |mid - 0.5|)
cb18_rules_pre.PIN_NOTE: live_tests3.* pinned at this commit from the merged integration branch (LT3's spec has no code pin yet); the cb17_* pins equal the CB17 part-pre func_sources_sha256 frozen in seals/cb17_rules.json and verify_pins checks them against that file too; a divergence refuses (never re-pinned silently)
cb18_rules_pre.PRIOR_QUIET_RULE: census control: consecutive prior intervals (k - j - 1, k - j), j = 1 .. 11, that are capture-quiet (both captures present and open, every (8) field incl. the chg_* byte flags equal, (10) met, updated_at present and equal); the book-untouched rule is NOT applied to prior intervals in the census (sweeps of 2026-10-14 are not pinned); a missing capture before the chain breaks or reaches 11 makes the count unknown -> lookback_unavailable (declared gap) or lookback_missing (other)
cb18_rules_pre.PROXY_SE_RECIPE: SE only (no point estimate leaves the function): within-market fixed-effect OLS (cb17_pre.fe_cluster_se, pinned) of the pre-origin proxy on the tested label first plus the declared controls; CR1 per way; the census SE is the MAX over the event way and the UTC 6 h block way whatever their G (no UTC-day or two-way way at G = 2; section 2.4); units in cents. S: Y_pre = |mid_k - mid_{k-12}| x 100 on silent + quiet units thinned at q, controls = log1p volume24hr_k, spread_k, |mid_k - 0.5|, log hours to the as-of end (capped at 30 d; 0 and an unknown flag if unknown), dormancy, prior-quiet count (cap 11), the event_comment_count change flag, UTC 6 h band dummies (the two |mid| controls left out); lookback_unavailable and lookback_missing units are left out. P: c_pre = s x (mid_{k-2} - mid_{k-4}) x 100 on fade, follow and none units, regressors 1[fade], 1[follow], log |x|, spread_k, log1p volume24hr_k, pass k + 1 stratum dummies; the SE of the 1[fade] coefficient
cb18_rules_pre.P_EFFECTIVE_RULE: effective = units in markets with >= 2 units of the tested population (fade or none) over the 21 usable pass pairs
cb18_rules_pre.P_ROUTE_RULE: non-sports primary if GP1-GP6 hold on non-sports units; else all categories (sports split reported) if they hold on all categories; else dropped uncounted. A pass -> LT5 member. No 42-day branch.

RS_RULES.RS-0: any of GS1-GS4 fails, or GS5 fails at both q_CB and q_LT -> CB18-S dropped uncounted (recorded with counts)
RS_RULES.RS-1: gates pass (GS5 at q_CB) and MDE_RS1 = 3.80 x SE_proxy(q_CB) x sqrt(census days / 14) x sqrt(2) x sqrt(max(3, DE_W14 / DE_census)) x 1.5 <= 1.0c -> CB route (parts common, S); NaN SE -> section 2.4 formula (M 3.80, SD 6c, projected arm-0 silent n1, projected thinned arm-0 quiet n0, DE_gate, 1.5)
RS_RULES.RS-2: else, gates pass (GS5 at q_LT) and MDE_RS2 = 3.388 x SE_proxy(q_LT) x sqrt(census days / 28) x sqrt(max(3, DE_W28 / DE_census)) x 1.5 <= 1.0c -> LT5 member; NaN SE -> formula with M 3.388 and unsplit 28-day counts
RS_RULES.both: MDE_RS1 and MDE_RS2 are both written into the routing record whichever route is taken (Q5)

cb18_rules_pre.R_COVERAGE_RULE: E016's rule: a sampled market (features status ok) is covered iff n_returned < 500 (trade_sample.TRADE_LIMIT) or its oldest row has ts <= origin - 6 h
cb18_rules_pre.R_QUANTISED_RULE: ts is read as quantised at 2 s or coarser iff the gap histogram holds >= 100 gaps of 1-10 s and 1-s gaps are < 5% of them; then every 'same second' in the map reads 'same block'
cb18_rules_pre.R_RACE_RULE: a row is raced iff another row of the same market has the same ts and a different tx_hash (same ts and same tx_hash is not a race); a blank tx_hash never partners
cb18_rules_pre.SPREAD_RULE: spread = the capture's Gamma spread field if finite, else ask - bid; a band or cap edge is compared with a 1e-12 tolerance (spread <= 0.10 + 1e-12; mid in [0.02 - 1e-12, 0.98 + 1e-12])
cb18_rules_pre.SWEEP1_RULE: sweep 1 of pass k = the book_sweeps directory whose manifest has snapshot_id = capture k's id, series_index 0 and state complete; its time is the token row's batch_receipt_utc
cb18_rules_pre.S_DE_POPULATION: silent non-sports units passing (1)-(11) (after the burst exclusion), by Gamma event id (else market id)
cb18_rules_pre.THIN_RULE: quiet units kept iff int(sha256('cb18-thin-v1|' + market_id + '|' + slot_iso).hexdigest()[:8], 16) / 2^32 < q; q_CB = the largest of {1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8} whose projected arm-0 14-day frame (silent + q x quiet, arm-0 share by the event-arm hash, x 14 / census days) is <= 1.5 M rows; q_LT the same on the unsplit 28-day frame; fixed from counts before its proxy SE; none qualifies -> q = null and the route's MDE is NaN (fails)
cb18_rules_pre.UMA_LITERAL_RULE: (10) holds iff the raw bytes at k - 1 and k are equal AND the bytes at k equal UMA_EMPTY_LITERAL exactly; a missing value (empty field) is class 'missing' and fails (10) (unknown never counts as met, L2); any other bytes are 'non_empty' and fail (10)
cb18_rules_pre.UNAVAILABLE_RULE: in no host copy and in no release (checked against the committed catalogues through data-20261020-dsheikh); never 0, never interpolated; the off-grid -val copy 20261013T231958Z_80e78ef1 is never used
